title: POST /merchants/masters/provision
$comment: currency is a ledger currency exactly as the master rows are keyed (MASTER#<currency>), so a lower-case one would make a master that getMasterAccount never finds. merchantId is mrc_<hex> for a registered merchant, but older ones (internal-001, e2e-hmac) have other shapes; the handler answers 100040 for one that does not exist.
